title: Museum London

services.name: Art Tours
services.desc: A school visit to Museum London offers students a hands-on, curriculum-connected experience. Led by expert guides and staff, programs explore Canadian art and regional history through exhibitions and artifacts, sparking curiosity and creativity in an interactive setting designed to inspire learners at every grade level. Booking requests must be submitted through our online form. Once received, our staff will be in touch to confirm your visit. Museum London offers curriculum-connected tours for Kindergarten to Grade 12. services.name: Virtual Exhibitions
services.desc: Our curatorial team engages in ongoing research. This includes exploring current and emerging artistic practices, diverse cultural conversations, and historical narratives that resonate with our community and mandate. We welcome digital submissions from artists and curators interested in sharing their work or touring exhibitions. Send a link to your website, online portfolio, or proposal to curatorial@museumlondon.ca. Due to the high volume of submissions we receive, we’re unable to respond to each one individually.
